title: The Little Ant's Big Thank You
source_detail: Story of Prophet Sulayman and the ants
description: A tiny ant learns the power of saying thank you when Prophet Sulayman's army passes by. Join this little creature as it discovers that gratitude is the biggest gift we can give.

title: The Boy Who Shared His Last Date
source_detail: Verse about those who feed the poor
description: A hungry boy faces a choice: keep his last date for himself or share it with a friend. Discover how his generous heart brings more blessings than he could imagine.

title: The Light of Patience — The Story of Young Yusuf
source_detail: Story of Prophet Yusuf's early life and dreams
description: Young Yusuf has a beautiful dream, but his journey is not easy. Learn how patience and trust in Allah guide him through dark times toward the light.

title: The Shepherd's Promise
source_detail: Prophet Musa's early life tending sheep
description: A young shepherd makes a promise to protect his flock. Through kindness and care, he learns what it means to be trustworthy.

title: The Banana and the Lesson of Kindness
source_reference: Hadith: Abu Huraira reported, the Prophet said, 'Every joint of a person must perform a charity every day...kindness is charity'
source_detail: Sahih Bukhari 973 - Acts of kindness as charity
description: Amira brings a banana to share, not knowing it will turn her ordinary day into something extraordinary and teach her about the joy of giving.

title: The Rainbow After the Rain
source_detail: Surah Al-Inshirah - verily with hardship comes ease
description: After a scary storm, little Zara learns that every difficulty brings something beautiful. A gentle story about finding hope and trust.

title: The Night Star's Secret
source_detail: Surah An-Najm opens with the star
description: A lonely little star wonders if it matters. That night, it guides a lost traveler home and discovers its special purpose.

title: The Honest Fisherman
source_reference: Hadith: The Prophet said, 'The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best among you'
source_detail: Tirmidhi 3895 - Honesty and truthfulness
description: A fisherman finds something precious in his nets. His choice to return it teaches us that honesty is worth more than anything.

title: The Lion's Mercy
source_detail: Verses about mercy and justice
description: A powerful lion chooses mercy over revenge. Through this majestic tale, discover that true strength lies in compassion.

title: The Well of Kindness
source_detail: Story of Prophet Yusuf and the well
description: A boy thrown into a well learns to forgive. Follow his journey as he discovers that letting go of anger brings freedom.

title: The Bird's Trust
source_detail: Do they not see the birds held up in the sky?
description: A young bird learns to fly by watching how Allah sustains all creatures. A beautiful story about faith and letting go.

title: The Camel's Lesson
source_reference: Hadith: The Prophet said, 'A good deed done to an animal is like a good deed done to a human being'
source_detail: Sahih al-Bukhari 5663
description: A mistreated camel is rescued and cared for. Through this animal's journey, learn about treating all creatures with dignity.

title: The Seed of Change
source_detail: The parable of the seed bearing seven ears
description: A child plants a tiny seed and waits. Watch as patience and small actions grow into something beautiful and meaningful.

title: The Moon's Friendship
source_detail: He created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon
description: The moon befriends the stars and learns what it means to shine together. A warm story about friendship and support.

title: The King's Secret
source_detail: Story of the two gardens - humility vs. arrogance
description: A proud king learns that his greatest wealth cannot protect him from loss. Discover why humility is the truest sign of power.

title: The Lost Caravanserai
source_reference: Historical references to Islamic trade routes and waystations
source_detail: Inspired by the caravanserai system during Islamic Golden Age
description: A traveler must find a legendary caravanserai where justice reigns. Follow this adventure as it explores mercy, fairness, and integrity.

title: The Cave of Courage
source_detail: Story of Prophet Muhammad and Abu Bakr in the cave
description: In a dark cave with enemies outside, a believer learns that true courage comes from faith. A powerful tale of trust and bravery.

title: The Weaver's Wisdom
source_detail: Call to wisdom and good counsel
description: An old weaver teaches a young apprentice that every thread, even the dark ones, has its place in the pattern. A meditation on life's complexity.

title: The Spider's Lesson
source_detail: The parable of the spider's web
description: A little spider weaves with care but learns an important lesson about strength and weakness. A thoughtful story about understanding ourselves.

title: The Traveler's Thirst
source_reference: Hadith: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet said, 'Whoever gives a drink to a thirsty person'
source_detail: Sunan Ibn Majah 4193 - Reward for giving water
description: A traveler is desperately thirsty when a child offers water. This simple act of kindness ripples through the community in unexpected ways.

title: The Garden's Guardian
source_detail: Reference to the Garden of Eden
description: A young gardener tends to flowers with love and care. Watch as the garden blooms into a sanctuary where everyone feels welcome.

title: The Forgotten Well
source_reference: References to wells in Islamic history and the Prophet's practices
source_detail: Historical significance of wells in Islamic civilization
description: A village's old well is abandoned until one child remembers its value. Together, they restore it and bring the community back together.

title: The Patient Potter
source_detail: He created you from a single soul
description: A master potter shapes clay with patient hands. As his student learns the craft, she discovers how patience transforms raw material into beauty.

title: The Shepherd and the Lost Lamb
source_detail: Story of Prophet Ibrahim and his devoted son
description: A shepherd searches tirelessly for his lost lamb. This tender story shows us the depth of responsibility and care in guiding those we love.

title: The Merchant's Choice
source_detail: Verse about honesty in business transactions
description: A merchant faces temptation to deceive for profit. Watch as he chooses integrity and discovers it's worth more than any treasure.

title: The River's Song
source_detail: Description of rivers in Paradise
description: A gentle river flows and sings, bringing life and sustenance to all. A soothing bedtime tale about the beauty of flowing with purpose.

title: The Echo of Kindness
source_reference: Hadith: 'None of you truly believes until he wishes for his brother what he wishes for himself'
source_detail: Sahih Muslim 45 - Brotherhood and kindness
description: A child's kind words echo through the village, returning magnified. Discover how goodness ripples through the community.

title: The Night Visitor
source_detail: Story of Prophet Ibrahim's guests
description: A weary traveler arrives at night and is welcomed with open arms. This tale celebrates the Islamic virtue of generous hospitality.

title: The Mender of Hearts
source_detail: About reconciling between believers
description: An old wise woman helps enemies become friends again. Learn how forgiveness heals wounds and brings peace to troubled hearts.

title: The Cloud's Purpose
source_detail: Description of how clouds are formed and bring rain
description: A fluffy cloud wonders what it's for until it brings precious rain to a thirsty land. A gentle story about discovering our special purpose.

title: The Student's Question
source_detail: Ask for increase in knowledge
description: A curious student asks questions others fear to ask. Through her journey, she learns that seeking knowledge and truth brings enlightenment.

title: The Rescued Gazelle
source_reference: References to hunting practices and animal treatment in Islamic texts
source_detail: Islamic teachings on compassion toward animals
description: A hunter's son saves a gazelle from a trap. Watch as he learns that sometimes the noblest choice is to let the hunted go free.

title: The Bread Maker's Secret
source_reference: Hadith about the blessings of work
source_detail: Islamic teachings on honest labor
description: A baker kneads dough with love and whispers gratitude with each fold. Discover the sacred in everyday work and humble provision.

title: The Mirror of Truth
source_detail: Reference to understanding and reflection
description: A young person looks in a magical mirror that shows truth. Through difficult reflections, they learn to accept themselves and grow.

title: The Mountain's Humility
source_detail: Reference to mountains and their creation
description: A tall mountain discovers that even the mightiest must humble themselves before Allah. A meditative story about strength and submission.

title: The Fair Judge
source_detail: Verse about just administration
description: A fair ruler must judge between two parties seeking justice. Through wisdom and impartiality, learn how justice serves the community.

title: The Grateful Hearts
source_detail: Be grateful to Allah
description: Three siblings find simple joy in small blessings. A heartwarming tale about counting our gifts and saying thank you.

title: The Healer's Herbs
source_reference: Hadith about Allah's cure for every ailment
source_detail: Islamic teachings on healing and medicine
description: A village healer gathers herbs to help the sick. This gentle story celebrates the mercy of those who dedicate themselves to caring.

title: The Prophet's Smile
source_reference: Hadith: Abu Dharr reported the Prophet said 'Smiling at your brother is a charity'
source_detail: Tirmidhi 1956 - Acts of kindness
description: A simple smile from a kind man transforms everyone's day. Discover how small gestures of warmth create ripples of joy.

title: The Fortress of Faith
source_detail: Verse about faith and Allah's protection
description: A soldier learns that true protection comes not from walls of stone, but from unwavering faith. A powerful tale of spiritual strength.

title: The Whispering Wind
source_detail: Reference to the wind carrying messages
description: The wind carries secrets and stories to those who listen. A dreamy bedtime tale about nature's gentle messages.

title: The Elder's Gift
source_reference: Hadith: 'The best of you are those who have the best manners and character'
source_detail: Al-Tirmidhi - Akhlaq (Good Character)
description: An elderly teacher gives the greatest gift: the wisdom of patience and understanding. Learn why experience and kindness matter.

title: The Otter's Lesson
source_reference: Islamic teachings on the importance of cleanliness (tahara)
source_detail: Hadith about cleanliness as part of faith
description: A little otter learns the joy of being clean and fresh. A playful story about self-care and the importance of staying pure.

title: The Tent of Welcome
source_reference: References to Bedouin hospitality in Islamic tradition
source_detail: Islamic cultural emphasis on welcoming guests
description: A family opens their tent to a stranger, not knowing he will change their lives. A beautiful story about generous hearts.

title: The Silent Listener
source_detail: About those who listen and remember
description: A boy who listens more than speaks learns the deepest secrets of the world. A thoughtful story about the power of attention.

title: The Lost Tradition
source_detail: Historical narratives of learning and knowledge transmission
description: A youth discovers a forgotten tradition of his ancestors and works to restore it. Learn about honoring our roots and identity.

title: The Faithful Servant
source_detail: About serving with faith and sincerity
description: A humble servant does their work with complete devotion. Discover that dignity comes not from status, but from sincere effort.

title: The Twin Butterflies
source_detail: We send the winds to fertilize
description: Two butterfly siblings stay together through their adventure. A sweet bedtime tale about the power of brotherly and sisterly love.

title: The Broken Vessel
source_detail: With hardship comes ease
description: A vessel breaks and appears useless, but is repaired and becomes more beautiful. A metaphor for overcoming trials and growing stronger.

title: The Dawn Prayer's Promise
source_detail: References to prayer times and spiritual devotion
description: A young seeker discovers the transformative peace of morning prayer. A meditative story about spiritual awakening and starting fresh.

title: The First Eid Morning
source_detail: Celebration and gratitude after Ramadan — completing the fast and giving thanks to Allah
description: A little child wakes up to the magical sounds and smells of Eid morning. New clothes, sweet treats, and hugs from everyone — a joyful celebration of gratitude and love.

title: The Merchant's Lost Camel
source_detail: Tie your camel, then put your trust in Allah — the balance between effort and tawakkul
description: A young boy searches for his father's lost camel across the desert. After doing everything he can, he learns the beautiful balance of effort and trust in Allah.

title: The Scholar's Long Journey
source_detail: Seek knowledge even if you have to go as far as China — the Prophet's (peace be upon him) encouragement to pursue learning
description: A determined young student travels far to study with a great scholar. Through hardship and wonder, she discovers that the pursuit of knowledge is itself an act of worship.

title: Soap and Stars
source_detail: Cleanliness is half of faith — the Prophet's teaching on taharah
description: Little Zara learns to wash her hands before every meal and make wudu before prayer. She discovers that being clean on the outside helps her feel bright and sparkly on the inside.

title: The Two Gardens
source_detail: For whoever fears the standing before their Lord are two gardens — generosity and sharing what we love
description: Two neighbors each tend a beautiful garden. One keeps all its fruit for himself; the other shares with every visitor. A warm story about the joy that comes from open-handed giving.
